title: tap-icmpv6stat: fix memory management
description:
`icmpv6stat_reset()` would leak the pointer to the filter string, since it
zeroed out the memory structure which held it. Fix by zeroing out the
statistics individually.

`icmpv6stat_reset()` would also leak all the entries in its `rt_list`,
which are `g_new()`-allocated pointers to `double`s. Fix by using
`g_slist_free_full()` instead of `g_slist_free()`.

Update comments which indicate some functions are only called once or
not at all, with a reference to #20432.

Add `icmpv6stat_finish()` for freeing the memory allocated by the tap
listener. Include an informational comment in keeping with those on the
other functions.

Ping #20432
